name: efficient-browser-use
description: Shrinks the screenshots and other pictures tool results carry before Claude reads them, so browser work costs fewer tokens. Linux, with ImageMagick

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: shrink: Claude reads a smaller picture. describe: a Haiku subagent writes the picture out in words and Claude reads those; text in a picture then reaches Claude as words, so a page can put instructions in front of it

percent.title: Scale, percent
percent.description: How big the picture Claude reads is, as a percent of the size the tool returned

minLongSide.title: Smallest long side, px
minLongSide.description: A picture is never made smaller than this on its long side, and one already this size or smaller is left alone

logDecisions.title: Log every picture
logDecisions.description: Write each picture's sizes to mods-logs/efficient-browser-use.log in the Claude Code configuration folder
